chosen: Online editing becomes actually usable for v2 composition fields.
why: After v0.17.0 made components machine-checkable, the next bottleneck is the human editing loop: selecting a track, typing in inspector fields, seeing preview update, saving JSON, and exporting the same saved source must feel stable instead of fragile.
changed_from: v0.17.0 completed component registry validation and advanced milestones to v0.18.0.

constraints.no_vanity: 本版看得见的效果 = inspector 输入不掉焦点、保存状态清楚、导出使用保存后的 JSON。
constraints.no_overreach: 本版只做 v2 composition 在线编辑可用性 · 不做 TTS 生成闭环 / 新组件体系 / 云导出 / 大改设计。
constraints.no_rush: 不是临时绕过。输入、预览、保存、CLI devtools 验证都走同一事件路径。
constraints.must_verify: 验收画面 = 打开 showreel-24s, 选 final-title, 改 params.title, 预览和 JSON 同步, draft export source 也同步。自验方法 = devtools fill + composition show + export source jq。

success_picture: PM 看到编辑器里选中一条轨道，直接在右侧字段输入标题，预览马上变；离开输入框后状态变 saved；导出后 source JSON 仍是这个标题。
risks: Inspector attribute rerender may interrupt active inputs.
Devtools fill must not bypass the same input/change path as a human edit.
Verification must avoid permanently mutating source examples without restoring them.

candidates.title: Online editing usability
candidates.why: Current roadmap item and highest PM-visible bottleneck.
candidates.constraints_check: One visible editing loop, easy to verify with CLI and screenshot.

candidates.title: TTS/subtitle generation loop
candidates.why: Valuable, but should not mix with editor usability.
candidates.constraints_check: Would add generation/backend concerns; defer to v0.19.0.

candidates.title: Editor quality audit
candidates.why: Useful quality slice, but v0.18 already has a concrete PM-visible feature.
candidates.constraints_check: Keep audit as closeout gate rather than main version theme.

verify_points.desc: Selecting a v2 composition track exposes stable editable inspector fields with AI-addressable selectors.
Typing into a composition field updates preview immediately without rerendering away the active input.
Blur/change saves the typed value through the same IPC path, preserving numeric values as numbers.
A draft export after save uses the saved composition JSON in its source sidecar.
